description: Use when an agent sizes a Hyperliquid market order or compares liquidity. Input: coin (perp or HIP-3 xyz:TSLA), optional sizes_usd (up to 5, default 1000,10000,100000), levels (0-20). Output: JSON best bid/ask, spread bps, depth USD within 0.1/0.5/1/2%, imbalance, per size buy/sell average fill, worst price and slippage bps vs mid, top levels. Cached 3 s. Example: ?coin=BTC&sizes_usd=1000,10000 Price: $0.0036 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

coin.description: Hyperliquid perp symbol (BTC, ETH, kPEPE) or HIP-3 dex:COIN (xyz:TSLA). Not listed or delisted: 400 before payment (not charged)

levels.description: Book levels per side to return (0-20, default 10)

sizes_usd.description: 1-5 comma-separated order notionals in USD, 10 to 50,000,000 (default 1000,10000,100000)

name: hl_orderbook
title: Hyperliquid order book depth and slippage: spread, depth bands, imbalance, fill price for $1k-$100k
